name: weex-agent-skills-local-evals
description: Local deterministic Promptfoo evaluations for WEEX Agent Skills

scripts.eval:codex:json: node scripts/run_codex_promptfoo.cjs eval --config promptfooconfig.codex.yaml --no-cache --no-share --no-progress-bar --no-table --max-concurrency 2 --output artifacts/codex-model-eval.json artifacts/codex-model-eval.html
scripts.eval:codex:html: node scripts/run_codex_promptfoo.cjs eval --config promptfooconfig.codex.yaml --no-cache --no-share --no-progress-bar --no-table --max-concurrency 2 --output artifacts/codex-model-eval.html artifacts/codex-model-eval.json
